name: @go-git-cms/example-sample-site
description: A personal profile starter — Astro + Tailwind, block-composed pages, modelled end to end in go-git-cms.yml.
// dependencies: piccolore and zod are astro's own deps, re-imported bare by the BUILT server (dist/server/chunks). dist/ sits outside any package, so its imports resolve only against this package's top-level node_modules — under pnpm's strict linking, astro's nested copies are invisible there and the pruned production install (Dockerfile.sample-site's `pnpm deploy`) crashes on boot without these. Same ranges astro declares, so they dedupe to one copy.
// devDependencies: @go-git-cms/preview is the editor-side preview plugin cms.config.mjs names; the CMS resolves it from this directory, but Astro never imports it, so it stays out of the runtime dependency graph.
